versions.content: For Time Bases 16 t o 31 the StbM_GetCurrentTime() and StbM_GetCurrentTime Extended () shall return for the requested Time Base an absolute time value calcula ted by adding the given offset to the current Time Base of the referenced Time Base via StbMOffsetTimeBase ( ECUC_StbM_00030 : ).

For Time Bases 16 to 31 StbM_GetCurrentTime shall return for the requested Time Base the current Time Tuple [TL abs , TV], the related Status and the User Data, where TL abs is the absolute time value calculated by adding the Offset Value of the Offset Time Base to the current value TL of the underlying Synchronized Time Base referenced via StbMOffsetTimeBase .
